CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, November 15, 2023, 2023 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE OCTOBER 18, 2023 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  November 15, 2023
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, October 18, 2023
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:01 P.M. on Wednesday, October 18, 2023, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, and Commission
Member Massaro.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Hermano and Commission Member
Longoria.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE AUGUST 16, 2023 AND SEPTEMBER 20, 2023
REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Massaro
the August 16, 2023 minutes were approved. With a motion from President Canseco and a
second from Vice President Saunders the September 20, 2023 minutes were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission are continuing their research and will
return with more information to share at the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission
meeting regarding possible locations and type of art. Vice President Saunders has decided on the
Granada Park Gymnasium as her location and asked Director Macias if the City has a boom lift
and supporting equipment to supply a muralist as it costs approximately three thousand dollars to
rent a lift; Director Macias agreed to look into equipment and liability insurance direction from
Management.

STAFF REPORT
Recreation Supervisor Leonard shared event details for the 10th annual Alhambra Pumpkin Run
on Sunday October 29, 2023 and Veteran’s Day on Saturday November 11, 2023 at Alhambra
Park. The Alhambra Holiday Home Decorating applications will be sent out and begin on
November 6, 2023.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.
 COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Vice President Saunders asked if residents can host a Craft Fair and sell items from their front
yard, Director Macias agreed to speak with Code Enforcement and return with more information
from the Municipal Code at the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Massaro and second by Vice President Saunders, the
October 18, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:14 P.M.
